part.text:
Fixed. The change in `tokio/src/fs/file.rs:593` makes `AsyncRead::poll_read` for `tokio::fs::File` return `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately when the destination buffer has zero remaining capacity, instead of dispatching a zero-byte read to the blocking pool — which previously came back as 0 bytes on the next poll and was indistinguishable from EOF.

Validation:
- `empty_read` in `tokio/tests/fs_file.rs` (FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes, along with all 16 other fs_file tests.
- All other fs tests (`fs`, `fs_canonicalize_dir`, `fs_copy`, `fs_dir`, `fs_link`, `fs_open_options`, `fs_remove_dir_all`, `fs_remove_file`, `fs_rename`, `fs_try_exists`, `io_buf_reader`) plus io tests (`io_read_buf`, `io_panic`, `io_take`, `io_read`, `io_read_to_end`) pass.
- The single `fs_try_exists` failure is pre-existing on the untouched baseline (verified via `git stash`) and unrelated to this change.
